issue.title: Stop auto-closing issues on PR merge; hand off to In QA
issue.body:
## Summary

Stop using GitHub closing keywords (`Closes` / `Fixes` / `Resolves`) so merged PRs do **not** auto-close issues. Linked tickets stay open and move to **In QA** on Project 4 for QA review before Done.

## Current vs expected

**Current:** PR bodies use `Closes #NNN`, which auto-closes the issue on merge to `main`. Agents often set Status to **Done** after merge.

**Expected:** PR bodies use `Refs #NNN` (non-closing link). After merge (or when ready for QA), Project 4 Status moves to **In QA**. Issues stay open until QA completes; **Done** is set after QA (not by merge alone).

## Scope

**In scope:** Update agent/delivery docs, PR template, slash commands, and related QA/preview docs that instruct `Closes #NNN` or post-merge `Done`.

**Out of scope:** Automating the board move on merge (preview-build already best-effort moves to In QA); changing GitHub org settings.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] PR template and delivery rules use `Refs #NNN` instead of `Closes #NNN` / other closing keywords
- [ ] Docs instruct: after merge (or when ready for QA), set Project 4 Status to **In QA** — do not auto-close the issue
- [ ] Agents must not set **Done** solely because a PR merged; Done follows QA / human process
- [ ] QA preview / `.github` docs that mention `Closes #NNN` for linking are updated to `Refs #NNN`
- [ ] Stacked-PR guidance still avoids closing keywords on non-`main` bases

## Verification

- [ ] Grep repo for `Closes #` in agent/docs templates shows none as the preferred linking form (historical notes OK if they explain the change)
- [ ] Docs-only PR; no app code changes

## File pointers

- `.cursor/templates/pr-template.md`
- `.cursor/rules/delivery.mdc`, `project-board.mdc`, `docs.mdc`
- `.cursor/commands/create-pr.md`, `generate-pr-description.md`
- `docs/issue-tracking.md`, `docs/guides/project-board.md`, `docs/guides/qa-preview-testing.md`
- `.github/README.md`
